preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of edges m in Alice's graph must be between 0 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge in Alice's graph must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the total number of triangles in both Alice's and Bob's graphs.
